item.title: Ultra‐Long Helical CNFs 3D‐Networks as High‐Conductivity Current Collectors for Efficient Sodium Deposition
item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in confining a NiY diatomic catalyst within a 20 nm Cu layer on Al current collectors, enabling in-situ growth of ultra-long helical CNF 3D-networks. This yields high conductivity, uniform Na deposition, and dendrite suppression, achieving 99.49% Coulombic efficiency over 3000 h and stable full-cell cycling over 1500 cycles—offering a new diatomic-catalyst strategy for high-performance carbon-modified current collectors.
🏷 sodium metal battery · current collector · diatomic catalyst · carbon nanofibers · dendrite suppression

item.title: Interfacial Anion Activation for Durable Aqueous Zn-Ion Batteries
item.description:
افزودنی آلیل‌اوره با ایجاد ناحیه غنی از آنیون و کم‌آب، SEI هیبریدی غنی از ZnS روی آند Zn می‌سازد و پایداری باتری آبی Zn-ion را بهبود می‌دهد.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using an allylurea additive to create an anion-rich, water-deficient interfacial region, enabling electric-field-driven anion reduction and allyl cation-mediated conversion of sulfate into ZnS. This forms an organic-inorganic hybrid SEI. Its significance is markedly enhanced interfacial stability, yielding over 2500 h Zn||Zn cycling at 5 mA cm–2 and over 10,000 cycles in full cells.
🏷 aqueous Zn-ion battery · solid electrolyte interphase · allylurea additive · ZnS interphase · anion activation

item.title: Harnessing Asymmetric Electrode Dissolution for Highly Reversible Fluorination of Trivalent Metals to Enable Long-Life F-Ion Batteries
item.description:
با تنظیم انحلال نامتقارن الکترود و حلال کم‌کوئوردینه، فلوریناسیون برگشت‌پذیر فلزات سه‌ظرفیتی در باتری یون فلوراید و عمر چرخه‌ای طولانی فراهم می‌شود.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in combining multiscale solvent screening with asymmetric electrode dissolution regulation: a solid-state migration-fluorination mechanism at the FeF3 cathode minimizes dissolution, while Al3+ complexation-dissolution-redeposition converts insulating AlF3 into soluble complexes, enabling reversible Al anodes for the first time. Significance: low-polarization, highly reversible F-ion batteries with 2000+ cycle life.
🏷 fluoride-ion battery · asymmetric dissolution · trivalent metal · weakly coordinating solvent · FeF3 cathode
